features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

features.name: Size
features.description: Half-orcs are somewhat larger and bulkier than humans, ranging from 5 to well over 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Thanks to your orc blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Menacing
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Savage Attacks
features.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Orc.
